body.title: Validate the slow profile on the UTM macOS guest
body.summary: After all implementation surrounding checks pass, use a committed built source in the existing ordinary-user UTM macOS guest. First establish qualified retired-worker closure/reconciliation through existing proof; retain iq-wZetTc stage, checkpoint and lease untouched while proof is absent. Once admitted, use a fresh home and retained detached supervisor under slow-vm for live official Node acquisition, offline reuse, private npm/build/payload/native consumers. Record exact source, OS/runtime, budget roles, stages and independent parent/worker closure in this story's evidence. Do not claim historical Linux or fixture Windows evidence as current native proof.
acceptanceChecks: Retired worker closure prerequisite is positively satisfied before a new qualification; PID/age/closed child commands alone do not suffice. If absent, record blocked with retained evidence and do not retry.
Fresh UTM run uses INSRC_QUALIFICATION_PROFILE=slow-vm and sufficient supervisor allowance, with Node22 and matching npm; CUDA skip is set only if absent.
Live acquisition, offline zero-network reuse, private build/payload/native consumer probes complete successfully with matching identity and full independent parent/worker closure.
No release enablement or host daemon/Ollama mutation; failed/missing native evidence remains unsatisfied. Feedback corrections go through affected task checks before completion.

Evidence explicitly distinguishes blocked admission, failed actual qualification and passing actual qualification; no native work overlaps canonical final regression. An unfulfilled prerequisite cannot mark t6 or story complete.
